## XpmLiquidBuildConfigurations.get() method

Retrieves a build configuration by name, creating it if required.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(buildConfigurationName: string): XpmLiquidBuildConfiguration;
```

## Remarks

This method implements lazy evaluation to avoid unnecessary operations. Build configurations are instantiated on demand but remain uninitialised until actually used. The two-step process works as follows:

1. During collection initialisation ([XpmLiquidBuildConfigurations.initialise()](./xpm-lib.xpmliquidbuildconfigurations.initialise.md)<!-- -->), only the matrix of options is evaluated for each template, expanding configuration names without processing their content.

2. Later, when a configuration is accessed via this method and subsequently initialised ([XpmLiquidBuildConfiguration.initialise()](./xpm-lib.xpmliquidbuildconfiguration.initialise.md)<!-- -->), the template is fully evaluated and Liquid substitutions are performed on all properties.

This approach ensures that only build configurations that are actually used incur the cost of template evaluation and variable substitution.
